book.name: Mataio
book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌa gaubanana aheu fare ihoze hauḡirotene, eꞌeanoꞌo iḡunadu ne uhiḡauhiḡano ihozifine zu haramifine onamiro.
Iesu zu Ioane Babatiso
Ioane Babatisoꞌa ḡuꞌa neḡano radiunuteꞌe zamaḡano Kerisoꞌa nagini haḡairoteꞌe hariḡa igiro. ꞌOugadu aniꞌe Iesu ḡadinoga veize ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa Iesu vaḡe tuḡuziro.
Ebu zeḡeꞌa Iesu ḡadiniro, “Ariꞌuma rae reiroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡahe? Mene reine, eme vaze ꞌahoga guhiniꞌumahe?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Bare onamadu zaeꞌa igiꞌeteꞌe zu horoneꞌeteꞌe Ioane ihonoꞌi.
Ubuma kuru azaḡaꞌe ehamuꞌohe, oda sauꞌa azaḡaꞌe edau ragaveꞌohe, refera azaḡaꞌe manoreꞌohe, teḡaze uhuḡa azaḡaꞌe igiꞌohe, rune azaḡaꞌe bare ḡabodeꞌohe ebu zahara azaḡaniꞌa hari manoḡa igiꞌohe.
Eḡe mazao fieꞌetaꞌaꞌe mene modeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe matuꞌe rudauꞌohe.”
Ioane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa iḡunirotene, Iesuꞌa Ioane moneo vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa ḡadahe ziro, “Za nagini horonoga veize haba bohaꞌa onamiro? Zavaraꞌa imi hudi naeninaeniꞌeteꞌe horonoga radu onamirohe?
Mene reine, za nagini horonoga veize onamiro? Dabua manomano vidaroteꞌe vazeḡa horonoga veize onamirohe? Mene, dabua manomano vidaroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe kini neo radiuꞌohe.
Tena nagini horonoga veize onamiro? Peroveta vazeḡahe? Oꞌe, eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, peroveta azaḡa vitizeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Ioane.
Ioane moneo Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro,

content.text: 'Ḡianoꞌi, eḡeꞌa ḡae zamao vaze ꞌahoga ibite tuḡuniꞌuma.
Aniꞌe ḡae zamao ḡae ibi ruhibiꞌuma.'

content: Eꞌanoꞌo eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, Ioaneꞌe rahao ꞌada fureraroteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa vitizoga. Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡanoꞌe ḡonaga vazeḡa zuni Ioane vitinoga.
Ioane Babatisoꞌa haramiroteꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo onao izidi, Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe hariḡaꞌe riḡa harame onameꞌohe. Ebu vaze inaraḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano diuḡeꞌohe.
Ioaneꞌa ꞌizema ariroteꞌe madaḡanoꞌe peroveta azaḡa zu Mose goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe moneo rae fureniro.
Zeḡeꞌa rae fureniroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa zaeꞌa mae ḡihinihi rae reine, zaꞌe ederiꞌuma, Ioaneꞌe ariꞌuma rae reiroteꞌe vazeḡa, Elia.
Teḡaḡeta vazeḡaꞌe faifaine egadu huga ederoꞌi.
Izidi azaḡaꞌe naginio idaziꞌuma? Zeꞌe tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌaniꞌa ne hunio ehoradu araheꞌeteꞌe heuḡa. Ze rovozadu none tahiꞌaḡaniꞌa mone tahiꞌaḡa mazao ꞌahige huauꞌohe,

content.text: 'Eme muio suraꞌi hodeha, rehano za mene zavoneha.
Ebu eme rune habaꞌano niau ḡoinaheha, rehano za mene nianeha.'

content: Ioane Babatisoꞌa aradu ogomu mene audo zu vaini vuḡa mene gagido. ꞌOugadu ze ꞌahige rae reiro, 'Ioaneꞌe vine sauꞌaḡeta.'

U Vaze Ubugaꞌe aradu ogomu auꞌohe ebu vaini vuḡa gageꞌohe. ꞌOugeꞌetene, ze ꞌahige raꞌohe, 'Ḡianoꞌi, aniꞌe ogomu fuꞌa zu vaini vuḡa fuꞌa. Ebu ani takesi azaḡa zu haḡai sauꞌa azaḡa teite tiburuꞌohe.' Rehano iniu Badiꞌa zamarone huhuzaḡa hegotiroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌazamarone huhuzaḡaꞌe duduḡa rae fureneꞌohe.”
Haḡai Sauꞌanonoꞌo Mene Ḡihureꞌeteꞌe Habaꞌa
Eꞌe madaḡano Iesuꞌe aneꞌa haḡai gigiꞌa ḡehaḡa haḡairoteꞌe habaꞌahabaꞌa azaḡa roziro, mazaḡa zeꞌe haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo mene ḡihuriro.
Aneꞌa ziro, “Korasini azaḡa, za aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Betesaida azaḡa, za aduga boro hidiꞌuma! Eḡeꞌa zae mazao haḡairoteꞌe haḡaiḡa gigiꞌaꞌe Turo zu Sidono
azaḡa mazao haḡaifone, ze dabuaze ḡuꞌa vidanadu vega vadinizeo ase ḡuzuheꞌenaꞌa, haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo ḡihurifo.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Badiꞌa kota madaḡano zaꞌe Turo zu Sidono azaḡa ufeta vitize aduga boro hidiꞌuma.

Kaperanauma azaḡa, zaꞌe adureo Badiꞌa haba tutuze itiꞌuma rae zamareꞌehe? Mene! Zaꞌe rune habaꞌano mae feuziꞌuma. Eḡeꞌa zae mazao haḡairoteꞌe haḡai gigiꞌaḡa Sodoma azaḡa mazao haḡaifone, zeꞌe haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo ḡihuradu izidi ꞌize radiuꞌefo.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Badiꞌa kota madaḡano zaꞌe Sodoma azaḡa ufeta vitize aduga boro hidiꞌuma.”
Eḡe Vaḡe Aradu Ahirize Ohonoꞌi

Eꞌe madaḡano Iesuꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, “Mama, ḡaꞌe adure zu raha Zuhiꞌaḡa. E niguꞌeꞌohe, mazaḡa ḡaeꞌa vaze huhuzaḡa zu edeḡa boro azaḡa mazaoꞌe ḡoere huga ꞌahiguḡa ꞌuꞌuru tiro, rehano tahiꞌa komeꞌa teigeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa mazaoꞌe rae fureniro.
Mama, a hube, ꞌouge haḡairotaꞌaꞌe ḡae ura.

Eḡe Mamaꞌa ḡau niduꞌa eḡe iniro. Vazeni ꞌahoga Ubuga aḡuꞌa, rehano Moga ane daꞌo edeḡa. Ebu vazeni ꞌahoga Moga aḡuꞌa, rehano ane Ubuga daꞌo zu Ubuganiꞌa Moga moneo ihozoga veize ohotiroteꞌe azaḡa daꞌo Moga edeḡa.
Taoḡa zu aduga odoheꞌeteꞌe azaḡa, eḡe vaḡe aroꞌi, ꞌougine eḡeꞌa ahirize ohoniꞌuma.
Eꞌe namiḡa zu roḡeḡa ꞌahine, eḡe ihore mae ḡihinadu
eḡe mazaonoꞌo edeḡa moꞌi. ꞌOugine, zamaze roḡeraꞌuma.
Mazaḡa eḡe ihoreꞌe mene riḡa
zu eꞌe hegotogaꞌe mene aduga.”

footnotes.text: Turo zu Sidonoꞌe Iuda mene habaꞌa.
